messages:
nina (People Ops): Heads-up: updated timeline and short checklist for this cycle. Self assessments due 2026-04-04 23:59 PT. Managers submit writeups by 2026-04-14 17:00 PT. Calibration week: 2026-04-20 to 2026-04-24.

alex (Eng Manager): Thanks! Is there a strict length for rating rationale? Don't want to pad but need context.

nina (People Ops): Aim for 4-6 sentences for rationale, plus 1 bullet for impact and 1 for growth. Use the Manager Packet (Drive) for examples.

harpreet (Manager, Data): For cross-team projects, should we attach partner confirmations?

nina (People Ops): Yes please attach partner corroboration when relevant. If you can't get it, note outreach attempts in the packet.

kevin (Recruiting): Operational note: Hiring Ops will limit external offer approvals on calibration days. We can approve urgent exceptions if requested with "Interview Exception" form.

review-bot: Uploaded: "Calibration Rubric v5.pdf" to People Ops folder.

alex (Eng Manager): One last: appeals window unchanged?

nina (People Ops): Appeals window = 7 business days after release. New this year: 48-hr timezone exception for APAC reviewers via Exceptions form (subject: "Review Extension - <team>"). DM for urgent cases.

nina (People Ops): We'll run two manager norming sessions next week; recording + slides posted. Thanks all!
